confirmed_contract.architecture: ResNet152 3D encoder/decoder with learned depth attention
confirmed_contract.input: uint8 ZYX, float32 division by 255 without clipping
confirmed_contract.precision: CPU fp32 supported; bf16 requires CUDA
confirmed_contract.reverse_on_depth33: slice [9,25), then reverse: source planes 24 through 9
confirmed_contract.window: nonperiodic Hann outer product normalized by its maximum, floor .001
confirmed_contract.encoding: round(255 * clipped probability), no min-max normalization

independent_patch_set_check.calculation: Enumerate full-frame stride32 64-square patches intersecting the half-open main ROI; compare to all patches in the 320-square crop. Equality includes order and complete patch support.

decision: Accept one bounded known-region 2D reverse comparison. The existing CT has nominal XY9.600000254 and Z9.599039497 micrometre spacing; the roughly .010 percent Z difference is disclosed and tolerated for this reused-input test, not described as exact isotropic 9.6 resampling.
limits: No new CT, no unknown-region run, no extra direction or 3D pass. CPU1, process commit4GiB, one inference process up to900s; first three patches are timed within that process and a projected overrun causes early termination. No checkpoint or model forward has been performed in study189.
